510801.name: Poison Laser
510801.description: Fires a laser beam from its neck, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The Nikke who is hit is afflicted with Toxic Substance Status and takes sustained damage, which can stack.

1512301.name: Poison Laser
1512301.description: Fires a laser beam from its neck, dealing damage to Nikkes. Its main body fires a poison laser, dealing damage to all Nikkes. Its clone fires a poison laser, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The Nikke who is hit is afflicted with Toxic Substance Status and takes sustained damage, which can stack.

1512303.name: Poison Bubble Missile
1512303.description: Fires a barrage of poison bubble missiles, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The Nikke who is hit is afflicted with Poison Bubble Status and takes sustained damage, which can stack. The missiles can be intercepted.
